list.name: ds_dw
list.label: SCOM Data Warehouse
list.description: Microsoft SQL Server data source for the OperationsManagerDW database. Chosen automatically if its name contains "Warehouse" or "DW"; otherwise pick it here.

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT h.DisplayName AS __text, h.DisplayName AS __value
FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
WHERE t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName IN ('MECM.SiteServer', 'MECM.ManagementPoint', 'MECM.DistributionPoint', 'MECM.SoftwareUpdatePoint', 'MECM.ServiceConnectionPoint', 'MECM.SQLServer', 'MECM.ServerComponent')
  AND h.DisplayName IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1
list.label: Configuration Manager server
list.name: cmhost
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT h.DisplayName AS __text, h.DisplayName AS __value
FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
WHERE t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName IN ('MECM.SiteServer', 'MECM.ManagementPoint', 'MECM.DistributionPoint', 'MECM.SoftwareUpdatePoint', 'MECM.ServiceConnectionPoint', 'MECM.SQLServer', 'MECM.ServerComponent')
  AND h.DisplayName IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

title: SCCM Monitoring - Performance

panels.description: Total processor time of each selected server.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0) AS time, h.DisplayName AS metric, AVG(p.SampleValue) AS value
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'Processor Information' AND r.CounterName IN ('% Processor Time')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${cmhost:singlequote}) AND i.InstanceName = '_Total'
  GROUP BY DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0), h.DisplayName
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.DateTime, h.DisplayName, AVG(p.AverageValue)
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE (DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) > 2880 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Perf.vPerfRaw x WHERE x.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()))
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'Processor Information' AND r.CounterName IN ('% Processor Time')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${cmhost:singlequote}) AND i.InstanceName = '_Total'
  GROUP BY p.DateTime, h.DisplayName
) x ORDER BY time

panels.title: Available memory (MB)

panels.description: Free space of each logical disk of the selected servers (the site server needs room on its content and inbox drives).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0) AS time, h.DisplayName + ' ' + i.InstanceName AS metric, AVG(p.SampleValue) AS value
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'LogicalDisk' AND r.CounterName IN ('% Free Space')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${cmhost:singlequote}) AND i.InstanceName <> '_Total'
  GROUP BY DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0), h.DisplayName + ' ' + i.InstanceName
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.DateTime, h.DisplayName + ' ' + i.InstanceName, AVG(p.AverageValue)
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE (DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) > 2880 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Perf.vPerfRaw x WHERE x.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()))
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'LogicalDisk' AND r.CounterName IN ('% Free Space')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${cmhost:singlequote}) AND i.InstanceName <> '_Total'
  GROUP BY p.DateTime, h.DisplayName + ' ' + i.InstanceName
) x ORDER BY time
